summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 5,672,685 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International on July 21, 2026, at a volume-weighted average price of 112.1801 pence per share (approx. $1.46). The purchases are part of an existing share buyback programme announced January 30, 2026, and the shares will be cancelled. This is a routine capital return transaction with no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change. As a foreign private issuer, the 6-K serves as the equivalent of a U.S. issuer's current report on Form 8-K for the buyback. Watch for continuation of the programme or completion announcements.
